prompt: Summarize the following meeting notes in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: The kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project focused on a three-phase rollout plan, starting with discovery in April and a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May. Key requirements were established, including an on-premise integration and coordination for the pilot, which will involve two part-time coordinators from the client's operations team. Action items were assigned for schedule revision, connector documentation, budget proposal planning, and coordinator confirmation, with a follow-up on pilot results expected in June.
